title: The boastful trader
body: A trader boasted that the tailor, famous for stealing from his customers, could never take even a coil of thread from him. He bet an Arab horse on it. Next morning he carried a piece of satin to the tailor's shop. The tailor greeted him with great warmth and began telling funny stories about rich men and misers. As the trader laughed, the tailor snipped away and tucked extra pieces of the cloth under his thighs. The trader closed his eyes with joy, forgot all about his bet and kept begging for one more joke. At last the tailor said that he had better stop, for if he told another story, the coat would be too tight for the trader, who would then weep tears of blood.

title: Lines from 'Man vs Nature' by Norman Littleford
body:
Read the lines given below from the poem 'Man vs Nature'.
Is Mother Nature telling us
the best way that she can
to stop the interference
and abuse she gets from man.

We forget that Nature gives us
all that keeps us living
we take it all and still want more
but never think of giving.
